Name: Mister Ginger (cat NPC)
Author: lemurkat
Description:
He's a ginger cat that follows Jas around town, and pays visits to the other villagers. Some appreciate him, others do not. Like all good cats, he has numerous names.
As you may have guessed, Mister Ginger is not your average house cat.

Designed in conjunction with my Ranch Expansion mod. Both will run independently, but installing him as an actual character will increase the immersion (and mean he's more than just a character in a couple of Jas's cut-scenes).

Note: Whilst I tried to stay fairly close to the canon of the core game, I have expanded somewhat on a number of the characters and the lore. This made lead to a few lore contradictions with other mods that also expand on these.

Compatible with: Pretty much everything. Yes, that includes SVE.
Please let me know if you have any issues.
This mod adds several custom sprites for Shane. If you are using a program that adjusts Shane's sprites (ie: DSVO) may result in a temporary mismatch or lead to invisible characters. This is fleeting.

This is one of my first mods, and isn't quite as polished as my later ones; please post any bugs or typos in the "Bug Reports" file.

I would also like to recommend Axell's portrait mod:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10582] https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10582[/url] (More portrait mods can be found by clicking the "Requirements" tab).

TO INSTALL:
1. Make sure you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed.
2. Unzip/drag the entire folder into your Mods folder.
3. Open your game and meet the cat!

AS A HOUSEMATE:
Yes, you can invite Mr. Ginger to move in with you!
[u]Conditions:[/u]
- must be 10 hearts
- he will accept any extended family legendary fish
